attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Guam territory income tax calculation. Guam uses mirror code system - same rates as federal tax. Bona fide residents file with Guam Department of Revenue and Taxation instead of IRS. Non-residents use Form 5074 for income allocation per IRC 935.

initial_action.action_postfix: "GUAM TERRITORY TAX - Mirror Code System" job.audit_trail swap addto " Uses federal tax rates and rules (IRC mirror)" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.gu_income_tax xdef

condition_details.condition_description: Meets bona fide residence test (183+ days, tax home, closer connection)
condition_details.condition_postfix: result.gu_days_present 183 >= result.gu_has_tax_home and result.gu_closer_connection and dup /result.gu_bona_fide_resident xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate GU tax for bona fide resident using mirror code
action_details.action_postfix:
true /result.gu_files_with_drt xdef false /result.gu_files_with_irs xdef
result.federal_income_tax /result.gu_income_tax xdef
" Bona fide Guam resident - files with Guam DRT" job.audit_trail swap addto " Mirror code: uses federal tax rates (" result.filing_status strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Guam tax liability: $" result.gu_income_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

false /result.gu_bona_fide_resident xdef true /result.gu_requires_form_5074 xdef true /result.gu_files_with_irs xdef
result.gu_source_income 0 > if result.federal_income_tax result.gu_source_income f* result.agi f/ /result.gu_income_tax xdef " Non-resident with Guam source income - Form 5074 required" job.audit_trail swap addto " Guam tax allocated based on Guam-source income: $" result.gu_source_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Guam tax liability: $" result.gu_income_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto else 0.0 /result.gu_income_tax xdef " Non-resident with no Guam source income - no Guam tax" job.audit_trail swap addto then

policy_statement.policy_description: Calculate Guam territory tax for bona fide residents using mirror code
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Bona fide Guam residents file with Guam Department of Revenue and Taxation instead of IRS per IRC 935. Guam uses mirror code system with same rates as federal tax."

"Non-bona fide residents with Guam-source income must file Form 5074 to allocate income between Guam and US. Tax allocated proportionally based on Guam-source income. Must meet 183-day presence test for bona fide resident status."
